name: attachment
description: Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions.
purpose: Shows a file or image in composers, threads, and upload lists with status, metadata, and optional actions.
bestFor: upload queues with progress and retry
avoidFor: file managers with folders and bulk selection

examples.name: Default
examples.code: {attachmentMocks.images.map((image) => ( {image.name} {image.meta} ))} {attachmentMocks.uploading.title} {attachmentMocks.uploading.description} {attachmentMocks.file.title} {attachmentMocks.file.description}

examples.name: Variants
examples.code: {attachmentMocks.idle.title} {attachmentMocks.idle.description} design-system.zip Uploading · 64% {attachmentMocks.processing.title} {attachmentMocks.processing.description} {attachmentMocks.error.title} {attachmentMocks.error.description} {attachmentMocks.done.title} {attachmentMocks.done.description}
